posts.author: prohtex
posts.post_subject: Artist looking to commission a small hologram
posts.content_md:
Hi everybody, I'm an artist and photographer looking to commission a small holography studio, service, or individual with a home studio to make a hologram for me. I just got a copy of Graham Saxby's excellent "Manual of Practical Holography" and so I have some understanding of the technique, but not enough to do it on my own.

The source is a small object, about 10"x7"x7". I understand there are 12x16" or so plates? And that several plates are needed to create the hologram? I am looking for a reflection, not transmission, hologram. I am also working with a relatively short timeframe -- I would overnight you the object, and working time would be 2 weeks or less. Please respond if you're interested or send me an email at [pharkawik@gmail.com](mailto:pharkawik@gmail.com)

Thanks

Peter

posts.content_md:
Thanks, John!

By the way, this might be a good opportunity to reveal a "new" company. We've been criticised because we cover pretty much the length and breadth of holography, from display to embossed security to engineering to technical proof-of-concepts to pure science. The problem is: the tech/science clients see us as display and the artists/display lot see us as scientists and engineers.

So, we're trying to separate the two functions by creating a new identity for the display stuff. To this end, we registered a new company: 3d expressions. We also created the following site:

[http://www.3d-expressions.com/index.html](http://www.3d-expressions.com/index.html)
